repo.description: Respire CLI is open source: github.com/risense-ai/respire-cli
repo.title: Source code

site.description: rsrs.rs: what Respire is and how it works

provider.aiMemory: Your own ai-memory server: a Markdown wiki with full-text recall
provider.description: Every memory stays in Cocurdex on this device. A library adds its own recall and sync and is kept in step with it; switch at any time without losing memories.
provider.rsrs: Recall by meaning and encrypted multi-device sync; installs a local model of about 1.3 GB
provider.title: External library

rsrs.unsupported: rsrs has no build for this machine yet. Memory works without it.

status.installBlocked: rsrs stopped partway through a key handoff that only a newer rsrs can finish. Memory still recalls and saves; upgrade rsrs once a release with the fix ships.
status.installing: Installing rsrs and its local model; the first install can take 10+ minutes…
status.title: Status
status.unsupported: rsrs has no build for this machine yet.
status.upgradeRequired: rsrs {{installed}} on this machine is older than {{minimum}}, the oldest version Cocurdex supports. Cocurdex leaves rsrs out until you upgrade it, and memory keeps working from its own store. Cocurdex does not upgrade an rsrs it did not install.

sync.description: Cocurdex syncs on its own after changes and every few minutes.
sync.failed: Could not sync with the memory library
sync.title: Sync

userLibrary.description: Agent sessions also recall from the rsrs memory you set up yourself (~/.rsrs), as reference only. Cocurdex never writes to it, and its own memories win when the two disagree.
userLibrary.title: Also recall from my own rsrs
